 end
 local function solid(t)return (t>=0x2e and t<=0x33)or(t>=0x46 and t<=0x5e)or(t>=0x69 and t<=0x6c)or(t>=0x75 and t<=0x88)or(t>=0x8f and t<=0x9a)end
 if not jumpAt then jumpAt=-100;spellAt=-1000;spellPhase=0;stuck=0;lastX=x;lastScroll=0 end
 local sc=emu.read(0x60,m)+256*emu.read(0x61,m)
 if x==lastX and sc==lastScroll and st<2 then stuck=stuck+1 else stuck=0 end
 lastX=x;lastScroll=sc
 local ahead=solid(tile(x+16,y+2));local wall=solid(tile(x+16,y-12))

 end
